description: A single voltage-controlled amplifier, with a bar showing the gain in use

params.text: Attenuates the signal by hand; drag the bar up or down to set it

inputs.text: Controls the gain, 0% at 0V rising to 100% at 10V; voltages outside that range are clamped to the ends

outputs.text: The signal after the gain has been applied

menu: Exponential response — makes the gain rise exponentially with the control voltage rather than in proportion to it, which is how many hardware amplifiers behave
